mapper.sql: LEFT JOIN eqpmnt_info E ON E.EQPMNT_SN=D.EQPMNT_SN LEFT JOIN link_sys_info L ON L.LINK_SYS_CD=E.LINK_SYS_CD LEFT JOIN stn_info S ON S.STN_CD=E.STN_CD LEFT JOIN eqpmnt_clsf_info F ON F.EQPMNT_CLSF_CD=E.EQPMNT_CLSF_CD LEFT JOIN dsblty_type_info T ON T.DSBLTY_TYPE_SN=D.DSBLTY_TYPE_SN

sql.if: AND (D.DSBLTY_NO LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR E.EQPMNT_NM LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR E.EQPMNT_MNG_NO LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR D.DSBLTY_OCRN_CN LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%'))

mapper.select: SELECT LINK_SYS_CD AS linkSysCd, LINK_SYS_NM AS linkSysNm FROM link_sys_info WHERE USE_YN='Y' ORDER BY FIELD(LINK_SYS_CD,'EMS_TX','EMS_PIDS','SCADA_SEC','PBX','VMS'), LINK_SYS_NM
SELECT STN_CD AS stnCd, STN_NM AS stnNm FROM stn_info WHERE USE_YN='Y' ORDER BY STN_SEQ

SELECT COM_CD AS code, COM_CD_NM AS name, EXT1_CN AS ext1 FROM com_cd_info WHERE COM_CD_GROUP_ID='DSBLTY_GRD' AND COM_CD_USE_YN='Y' AND COM_CD IN ('EMERGENCY','HIGH','LOW','WARNING','INFO','CRITICAL','CAUTION') ORDER BY FIELD(COM_CD,'EMERGENCY','HIGH','LOW','WARNING','INFO','CRITICAL','CAUTION')
SELECT COM_CD AS code, COM_CD_NM AS name FROM com_cd_info WHERE COM_CD_GROUP_ID='PRCS_STTS' AND COM_CD_USE_YN='Y' ORDER BY COM_CD_SEQ, COM_CD

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN D.DSBLTY_GRD_CD IN ('EMERGENCY','CRITICAL') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS emergencyCount, SUM(CASE WHEN D.DSBLTY_GRD_CD='HIGH' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS highCount, SUM(CASE WHEN D.DSBLTY_GRD_CD IN ('LOW','CAUTION') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lowCount, SUM(CASE WHEN D.DSBLTY_GRD_CD='WARNING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS warningCount, SUM(CASE WHEN D.DSBLTY_GRD_CD='INFO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS infoCount FROM dsblty_info D
WHERE D.DSBLTY_END_DT IS NULL AND D.EXCP_APLY_YN='N' AND COALESCE(D.PRCS_STTS_CD,'UNCONFIRMED') NOT IN ('CONFIRMED','COMPLETED')

SELECT D.DSBLTY_NO AS dsbltyNo, D.EMS_ID AS emsId, D.SOU_EQPMNT_ID AS souEqpmntId, D.EQPMNT_SN AS eqpmntSn, E.EQPMNT_NM AS eqpmntNm, E.EQPMNT_MNG_NO AS eqpmntMngNo, E.EQPMNT_IP_ADDR AS ipAddr, E.EQPMNT_SE_CD AS eqpmntSeCd, E.INSTL_PLC_NM AS instlPlcNm, F.EQPMNT_CLSF_NM AS eqpmntClsfNm, E.LINK_SYS_CD AS linkSysCd, L.LINK_SYS_NM AS linkSysNm, E.STN_CD AS stnCd, S.STN_NM AS stnNm, D.DSBLTY_TYPE_SN AS dsbltyTypeSn, T.DSBLTY_TYPE_NM AS dsbltyTypeNm, D.DSBLTY_OCRN_PLC_NM AS dsbltyOcrnPlcNm, D.DSBLTY_GRD_CD AS dsbltyGrdCd, COALESCE(G.COM_CD_NM,D.DSBLTY_GRD_CD) AS dsbltyGrdNm, D.DSBLTY_OCRN_DT AS dsbltyOcrnDt, D.DSBLTY_OCRN_CN AS dsbltyOcrnCn, D.DSBLTY_RSN AS dsbltyRsn, D.DSBLTY_JGMT_CD AS dsbltyJgmtCd, D.PRCS_STTS_CD AS prcsSttsCd, COALESCE(P.COM_CD_NM,D.PRCS_STTS_CD) AS prcsSttsNm, D.IDNTY_USER_ID AS idntyUserId, D.IDNTY_DT AS idntyDt, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,D.DSBLTY_OCRN_DT,NOW()) AS elapsedSec, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dsblty_actn_hstry A WHERE A.DSBLTY_NO=D.DSBLTY_NO AND A.ACTN_SE_CD='TEMP' ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS tempActionYn FROM dsblty_info D
LEFT JOIN com_cd_info G ON G.COM_CD_GROUP_ID='DSBLTY_GRD' AND G.COM_CD=D.DSBLTY_GRD_CD LEFT JOIN com_cd_info P ON P.COM_CD_GROUP_ID='PRCS_STTS' AND P.COM_CD=D.PRCS_STTS_CD WHERE D.DSBLTY_END_DT IS NULL AND D.EXCP_APLY_YN='N' AND COALESCE(D.PRCS_STTS_CD,'UNCONFIRMED') NOT IN ('CONFIRMED','COMPLETED')
ORDER BY D.DSBLTY_OCRN_DT DESC, FIELD(D.DSBLTY_GRD_CD,'EMERGENCY','CRITICAL','HIGH','LOW','CAUTION','WARNING','INFO') LIMIT 500

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN D.PRCS_STTS_CD='UNCONFIRMED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unconfirmedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN D.PRCS_STTS_CD='TEMP_ACTN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tempCount, SUM(CASE WHEN D.PRCS_STTS_CD='COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completedCount FROM dsblty_info D
WHERE D.EXCP_APLY_YN='N' AND D.DSBLTY_OCRN_DT >= CONCAT(#{startDt},' 00:00:00') AND D.DSBLTY_OCRN_DT < DATE_ADD(CONCAT(#{endDt},' 00:00:00'),INTERVAL 1 DAY)

SELECT D.DSBLTY_NO AS dsbltyNo, D.EQPMNT_SN AS eqpmntSn, E.EQPMNT_NM AS eqpmntNm, E.EQPMNT_MNG_NO AS eqpmntMngNo, L.LINK_SYS_NM AS linkSysNm, S.STN_NM AS stnNm, T.DSBLTY_TYPE_NM AS dsbltyTypeNm, D.DSBLTY_GRD_CD AS dsbltyGrdCd, COALESCE(G.COM_CD_NM,D.DSBLTY_GRD_CD) AS dsbltyGrdNm, D.DSBLTY_OCRN_CN AS dsbltyOcrnCn, D.DSBLTY_OCRN_DT AS dsbltyOcrnDt, D.DSBLTY_END_DT AS dsbltyEndDt, D.DSBLTY_RSN AS dsbltyRsn, D.DSBLTY_JGMT_CD AS dsbltyJgmtCd, D.PRCS_STTS_CD AS prcsSttsCd, COALESCE(P.COM_CD_NM,D.PRCS_STTS_CD) AS prcsSttsNm, D.IDNTY_USER_ID AS idntyUserId, D.IDNTY_DT AS idntyDt, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,D.DSBLTY_OCRN_DT,COALESCE(D.DSBLTY_END_DT,NOW())) AS durationSec, (SELECT A.ACTN_CN FROM dsblty_actn_hstry A WHERE A.DSBLTY_NO=D.DSBLTY_NO ORDER BY A.ACTN_DT DESC,A.ACTN_SN DESC LIMIT 1) AS lastActionCn, (SELECT A.ACTN_PIC_NM FROM dsblty_actn_hstry A WHERE A.DSBLTY_NO=D.DSBLTY_NO ORDER BY A.ACTN_DT DESC,A.ACTN_SN DESC LIMIT 1) AS lastActorNm FROM dsblty_info D
LEFT JOIN com_cd_info G ON G.COM_CD_GROUP_ID='DSBLTY_GRD' AND G.COM_CD=D.DSBLTY_GRD_CD LEFT JOIN com_cd_info P ON P.COM_CD_GROUP_ID='PRCS_STTS' AND P.COM_CD=D.PRCS_STTS_CD WHERE D.EXCP_APLY_YN='N' AND D.DSBLTY_OCRN_DT >= CONCAT(#{startDt},' 00:00:00') AND D.DSBLTY_OCRN_DT < DATE_ADD(CONCAT(#{endDt},' 00:00:00'),INTERVAL 1 DAY)
ORDER BY D.DSBLTY_OCRN_DT DESC LIMIT 1000

SELECT D.DSBLTY_NO AS dsbltyNo,D.EMS_ID AS emsId,D.SOU_EQPMNT_ID AS souEqpmntId, D.EQPMNT_SN AS eqpmntSn,E.EQPMNT_NM AS eqpmntNm,E.EQPMNT_MNG_NO AS eqpmntMngNo, E.EQPMNT_IP_ADDR AS ipAddr,E.EQPMNT_SE_CD AS eqpmntSeCd,E.INSTL_PLC_NM AS instlPlcNm, F.EQPMNT_CLSF_NM AS eqpmntClsfNm, L.LINK_SYS_CD AS linkSysCd,L.LINK_SYS_NM AS linkSysNm,S.STN_NM AS stnNm, D.DSBLTY_TYPE_SN AS dsbltyTypeSn,T.EVNT_CD AS evntCd,T.DSBLTY_TYPE_NM AS dsbltyTypeNm, D.DSBLTY_OCRN_PLC_NM AS dsbltyOcrnPlcNm,D.DSBLTY_GRD_CD AS dsbltyGrdCd, COALESCE(G.COM_CD_NM,D.DSBLTY_GRD_CD) AS dsbltyGrdNm,D.OCRN_RCVR_SE_CD AS ocrnRcvrSeCd, D.DSBLTY_OCRN_DT AS dsbltyOcrnDt,D.DSBLTY_END_DT AS dsbltyEndDt, D.DSBLTY_OCRN_CN AS dsbltyOcrnCn,D.DSBLTY_RSN AS dsbltyRsn,D.DSBLTY_JGMT_CD AS dsbltyJgmtCd, D.PRCS_STTS_CD AS prcsSttsCd,COALESCE(P.COM_CD_NM,D.PRCS_STTS_CD) AS prcsSttsNm, D.IDNTY_USER_ID AS idntyUserId,D.IDNTY_DT AS idntyDt,D.EXCP_APLY_YN AS excpAplyYn, D.SRC_EVNT_NO AS srcEvntNo,D.LINK_RAW_SN AS linkRawSn,T.JGMT_CRTR_CN AS jgmtCrtrCn, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,D.DSBLTY_OCRN_DT,COALESCE(D.DSBLTY_END_DT,NOW())) AS elapsedSec FROM dsblty_info D
LEFT JOIN com_cd_info G ON G.COM_CD_GROUP_ID='DSBLTY_GRD' AND G.COM_CD=D.DSBLTY_GRD_CD LEFT JOIN com_cd_info P ON P.COM_CD_GROUP_ID='PRCS_STTS' AND P.COM_CD=D.PRCS_STTS_CD WHERE D.DSBLTY_NO=#{_parameter}

SELECT ACTN_SN AS actnSn,ACTN_SE_CD AS actnSeCd,ACTN_CN AS actnCn,DSBLTY_SYMPTM_CN AS symptom, DSBLTY_RSN AS reason,AFTR_PLAN_CN AS plan,ACTN_RSLT_CN AS result, ACTN_PIC_NM AS actorName,ACTN_USER_ID AS actorId,ACTN_DT AS actnDt,CTRL_CMD_CN AS ctrlCmdCn FROM dsblty_actn_hstry WHERE DSBLTY_NO=#{_parameter} ORDER BY ACTN_DT,ACTN_SN

SELECT T.DSBLTY_TYPE_SN AS dsbltyTypeSn,T.EVNT_CD AS evntCd,T.DSBLTY_TYPE_NM AS dsbltyTypeNm, T.LINK_SYS_CD AS linkSysCd,COALESCE(L.LINK_SYS_NM,'공통') AS linkSysNm, T.DSBLTY_OCRN_PLC_NM AS dsbltyOcrnPlcNm,T.DSBLTY_NM AS dsbltyNm, T.BSC_GRD_CD AS bscGrdCd,COALESCE(G.COM_CD_NM,T.BSC_GRD_CD) AS bscGrdNm, T.JGMT_CRTR_CN AS jgmtCrtrCn,T.AUTO_END_YN AS autoEndYn,T.SMS_USE_YN AS smsUseYn, T.USE_YN AS useYn,T.AUTO_REG_YN AS autoRegYn,T.REG_DT AS regDt,T.MDFCN_DT AS mdfcnDt FROM dsblty_type_info T LEFT JOIN link_sys_info L ON L.LINK_SYS_CD=T.LINK_SYS_CD LEFT JOIN com_cd_info G ON G.COM_CD_GROUP_ID='DSBLTY_GRD' AND G.COM_CD=T.BSC_GRD_CD WHERE 1=1 AND T.LINK_SYS_CD=#{linkSysCd} AND T.BSC_GRD_CD=#{grade} AND T.USE_YN=#{useYn} AND (T.EVNT_CD LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR T.DSBLTY_TYPE_NM LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR T.DSBLTY_NM LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')) ORDER BY COALESCE(L.LINK_SYS_NM,'공통'),T.EVNT_CD

SELECT T.DSBLTY_TYPE_SN AS dsbltyTypeSn,T.EVNT_CD AS evntCd,T.DSBLTY_TYPE_NM AS dsbltyTypeNm, T.LINK_SYS_CD AS linkSysCd,COALESCE(L.LINK_SYS_NM,'공통') AS linkSysNm,T.DSBLTY_OCRN_PLC_NM AS dsbltyOcrnPlcNm, T.DSBLTY_NM AS dsbltyNm,T.BSC_GRD_CD AS bscGrdCd,COALESCE(G.COM_CD_NM,T.BSC_GRD_CD) AS bscGrdNm, T.JGMT_CRTR_CN AS jgmtCrtrCn,T.AUTO_END_YN AS autoEndYn,T.SMS_USE_YN AS smsUseYn, T.USE_YN AS useYn,T.AUTO_REG_YN AS autoRegYn,T.REG_DT AS regDt,T.RGTR_ID AS rgtrId,T.MDFCN_DT AS mdfcnDt,T.MDFR_ID AS mdfrId FROM dsblty_type_info T LEFT JOIN link_sys_info L ON L.LINK_SYS_CD=T.LINK_SYS_CD LEFT JOIN com_cd_info G ON G.COM_CD_GROUP_ID='DSBLTY_GRD' AND G.COM_CD=T.BSC_GRD_CD WHERE T.DSBLTY_TYPE_SN=#{_parameter}

SELECT G.EXCP_GROUP_SN AS groupSn,G.EXCP_GROUP_NM AS groupNm,G.EXCP_GROUP_EXPLN AS groupExpln,G.USE_YN AS useYn, COUNT(R.EQPMNT_SN) AS memberCount FROM dsblty_excp_group_info G LEFT JOIN dsblty_excp_group_eqpmnt_rel R ON R.EXCP_GROUP_SN=G.EXCP_GROUP_SN GROUP BY G.EXCP_GROUP_SN,G.EXCP_GROUP_NM,G.EXCP_GROUP_EXPLN,G.USE_YN ORDER BY G.USE_YN DESC,G.EXCP_GROUP_NM

SELECT EXCP_GROUP_SN AS groupSn,EXCP_GROUP_NM AS groupNm,EXCP_GROUP_EXPLN AS groupExpln,USE_YN AS useYn,REG_DT AS regDt,MDFCN_DT AS mdfcnDt FROM dsblty_excp_group_info WHERE EXCP_GROUP_SN=#{_parameter}

SELECT R.EQPMNT_SN AS eqpmntSn,E.EQPMNT_NM AS eqpmntNm,E.EQPMNT_MNG_NO AS eqpmntMngNo, L.LINK_SYS_NM AS linkSysNm,S.STN_NM AS stnNm,R.ALL_IDCT_YN AS allIdctYn FROM dsblty_excp_group_eqpmnt_rel R JOIN eqpmnt_info E ON E.EQPMNT_SN=R.EQPMNT_SN LEFT JOIN link_sys_info L ON L.LINK_SYS_CD=E.LINK_SYS_CD LEFT JOIN stn_info S ON S.STN_CD=E.STN_CD WHERE R.EXCP_GROUP_SN=#{_parameter} ORDER BY COALESCE(S.STN_SEQ,999),L.LINK_SYS_NM,E.EQPMNT_NM

SELECT E.EQPMNT_SN AS eqpmntSn,E.EQPMNT_NM AS eqpmntNm,E.EQPMNT_MNG_NO AS eqpmntMngNo,E.LINK_SYS_CD AS linkSysCd, L.LINK_SYS_NM AS linkSysNm,E.STN_CD AS stnCd,S.STN_NM AS stnNm,E.EQPMNT_IP_ADDR AS ipAddr FROM eqpmnt_info E JOIN link_sys_info L ON L.LINK_SYS_CD=E.LINK_SYS_CD LEFT JOIN stn_info S ON S.STN_CD=E.STN_CD WHERE E.USE_YN='Y' AND E.LINK_SYS_CD=#{linkSysCd} AND E.STN_CD=#{stnCd} AND (E.EQPMNT_NM LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR E.EQPMNT_MNG_NO LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')) ORDER BY COALESCE(S.STN_SEQ,999),L.LINK_SYS_NM,E.EQPMNT_NM LIMIT 1000
mapper.delete: DELETE R FROM dsblty_excp_schdl_grd_rel R JOIN dsblty_excp_schdl_info S ON S.EXCP_SCHDL_SN=R.EXCP_SCHDL_SN WHERE S.EXCP_GROUP_SN=#{_parameter}
mapper.select: SELECT S.EXCP_SCHDL_SN AS scheduleSn,S.EXCP_GROUP_SN AS groupSn,G.EXCP_GROUP_NM AS groupNm, S.EXCP_SCHDL_NM AS scheduleNm,S.BGNG_DT AS bgngDt,S.END_DT AS endDt,S.REPT_CYCLE_CN AS reptCycleCn, S.EXCP_RSN AS excpRsn,S.USE_YN AS useYn, GROUP_CONCAT(R.DSBLTY_GRD_CD ORDER BY FIELD(R.DSBLTY_GRD_CD,'EMERGENCY','HIGH','LOW','WARNING','INFO') SEPARATOR ',') AS grades FROM dsblty_excp_schdl_info S JOIN dsblty_excp_group_info G ON G.EXCP_GROUP_SN=S.EXCP_GROUP_SN LEFT JOIN dsblty_excp_schdl_grd_rel R ON R.EXCP_SCHDL_SN=S.EXCP_SCHDL_SN WHERE 1=1 AND S.EXCP_GROUP_SN=#{groupSn} AND S.USE_YN=#{useYn} AND (S.EXCP_SCHDL_NM LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR S.EXCP_RSN LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')) GROUP BY S.EXCP_SCHDL_SN,S.EXCP_GROUP_SN,G.EXCP_GROUP_NM,S.EXCP_SCHDL_NM,S.BGNG_DT,S.END_DT,S.REPT_CYCLE_CN,S.EXCP_RSN,S.USE_YN ORDER BY S.BGNG_DT DESC,S.EXCP_SCHDL_SN DESC

SELECT S.EXCP_SCHDL_SN AS scheduleSn,S.EXCP_GROUP_SN AS groupSn,G.EXCP_GROUP_NM AS groupNm, S.EXCP_SCHDL_NM AS scheduleNm,S.BGNG_DT AS bgngDt,S.END_DT AS endDt,S.REPT_CYCLE_CN AS reptCycleCn, S.EXCP_RSN AS excpRsn,S.USE_YN AS useYn,S.REG_DT AS regDt,S.MDFCN_DT AS mdfcnDt FROM dsblty_excp_schdl_info S JOIN dsblty_excp_group_info G ON G.EXCP_GROUP_SN=S.EXCP_GROUP_SN WHERE S.EXCP_SCHDL_SN=#{_parameter}
SELECT DSBLTY_GRD_CD FROM dsblty_excp_schdl_grd_rel WHERE EXCP_SCHDL_SN=#{_parameter} ORDER BY FIELD(DSBLTY_GRD_CD,'EMERGENCY','HIGH','LOW','WARNING','INFO')
